AMENDEDANDRESTATEDZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THISAMENDEDANDRESTATEDZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT （"Agreement") made as of the 22nd day of March, 2004 by and between CENTRAL PARKING SYSTEM REALTY OF NEW YORK ("Owner"),a Tennessee corporation having an address c/o Central Parking System, 2401 21st Avenue South, Nashville, Tennessee 37212, and THE RC HOUSE LLC ("Developer"), a Delaware limited liability company having an office c/oJ.D.Carlisle Development Corp., 352 Park Avenue South,Suite 706,New York,NewYork 10010. WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the Owner in fee of a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of NewYork,known as Lot 45 in Block 1263 on the Tax Map of the City of NewYork, and by street address, 10-14 West 48th Street, New York, New York, and more particularly described in Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein called the "Owner Land", said buildings and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement, being herein called the “Owner Building", and the Owner Land and the Owner Building being herein collectively called the "OwnerPremises"); WHEREAS, Developer is the Owner in fee of a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of NewYork,known as Lots 48 and 49 in Block1263on the Tax Map of the City of New York,and by the street address of 16-20 West 48th Street, New York, New York,and more particularly described on Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein collectively called the “Developer Land", and the Developer Land and the buildings located thereon from time to time being herein collectively called the “Developer Premises"); WHEREAS,by execution of a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions, dated December 22, 2003"(the “Declaration"), Owner and Developer have utilized the procedure available pursuant to Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of NewYork,effective December 15, 1961, as amended (the“Zoning Resolution") to combine the Owner Land with the Developer Land so as to create a new, combined zoning lot (the “Combined Zoning Lot");
